title: A push the remote refuses for a reason other than divergence gets a card that quotes the reason and does not claim the branch diverged
description: After 55e27d6, `failureKind` (apps/daemon/src/git/network.ts) still gives `rejected` to any `[remote rejected]` whose reason is not on the server-error list, for example `(protected branch hook declined)`, `(push declined due to repository rule violations)` (GH013) or `(pre-receive hook declined)`. `shipCards.pushRejected` (apps/daemon/src/delivery/cards.ts) then says "origin's <branch> has commits this checkout doesn't … Reconcile the branch by hand". That is the same misleading claim the server-error task fixed: the branch may not exist on origin at all. network.test.ts even pins 'protected branch hook declined' as `rejected`.
acceptanceCriteria: Only a non-fast-forward / fetch-first / stale-info rejection gets the reconcile-by-hand card
A policy or hook rejection gets a card that quotes the remote's reason and names it as a repository rule or hook, with no claim of missing commits
Tests cover a rule-violation and a hook-declined stderr
